verses.text: Whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will find it.
verses.title: Called to Serve

verses.text: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace. And be thankful.

For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
